title: Free UNIVERSAL Script mobile and controller support
features:
SELF
Fly (custom speed)
No Clip (keybind)
Jet Pack
Infinite Jump
Speedhack (custom speed)
Jump Boost (custom height)
Long Neck (height) makes your camera slightly higher, in some games makes you able to shoot over wall
Hand Chams (Material/Color/Transparency)
Walk Fling
Air Swim
Goon (Animation)

PLAYERS
Select player
Advanced Friends System (Ignore friends from aimbot/esp/…)
Add Friend Bind
Teleport to player
Attach (position/distance)
Spectate
Look
Fling
Copy username/ID

Visuals (ESP)
Box
Name
Health text
Health bar
Current Weapon
Tracers
Skeleton
Distance
Head Dot
Chams
Options: team check, colors, max distance, chams transparency

ITEMS ESP
Inspector (What Am I Looking At)
Name
Distance
Chams
Tracers
Fully customisable items lists, colors, names, etc.

AIMBOT
Method (mouse/camera/silent aim)
Mode (hold/toggle)
Custom aim keys
Auto Shoot (bind)
Aim parts
Priority (FOV/distance/health/intelligent)
Smoothness
Sticky aim
Aim Shake (Intensity)
Prediction (Amount, Distance multiplier)
Bullet Drop Compensation
Hit Chance %
FOV Size, Circle
Target Line
Options: team check, wall check, FOV colors, size/360, retarget delay, Forcefield Check

TRIGGER BOT Auto shoot when a player is on your crosshair
Team check
Hold mode (custom key)
Min/max delay
Custom CPS
Miss chance %

RADAR
Minimap with player positions
Show names
Customizable size/position and colors
Options: team check, colors, transparency

RAGE
Spin bot (custom speed) Mostly only for visual, but in some games might make harder to hit you
Anti Aim (Jitter/Inverse) Breaks other cheaters aimbots if it uses prediction
TP All Players Loop (client-sided)
Options: team check, distance

Hitbox Expander
Head only mode
Show hitboxes
Reset all hitboxes
Options: team check, custom size, colors, transparency; Shape (Square/circle)

Raknet Desync (bindable)
Show last server position

TELEPORT
Click TP (Keybind)
Waypoints system (Load, save, teleport to, etc.)
Render Waypoints
TP To last death position
Render last death position

WORLD
Gravity changer
Time changer
Fullbright
Remove Fog
Remove Shadows
Ambient Color
Custom Sky (Blood Moon, Galaxy, Starry Night, Void)
Freecam (keybind)
TP to freecam position
Freecam speed / sprint speed

MISC
Anti AFK
Anti Void
Anti Fling
Anti Kick
Auto Rejoin
FOV changer
FPS boost
Instant Interacts
Unlock Camera Zoom
No Fall Damage
Third Person
Local Name Swoofer
Server hop (Random/Big/Small servers)
Rejoin server
Copy game/place ID

SETTINGS
Adonis Bypass (Automatic)
NPC Detection
Targets NPC Only
Custom Theme
Silent Load
Menu Key
Keybinds List (Optional: Show only enabled binds)
Config System (Save/Load/Auto load/...)
Global Script Chat
Configs Cloud (Online shared configs)
